sources.title: Chapter 8 Green Infrastructure
sources.verified_claim: London Plan Chapter 8 requires green infrastructure planning, open-space needs assessment, protection of open space and urban greening. Adopted strategic policy does not establish access, deficiency or UGF outcome for a sample parcel without spatial/proposal evidence.

sources.title: Urban Greening Factor (UGF) guidance
sources.verified_claim: The adopted UGF guidance explains how major development proposals quantify the amount and quality of urban greening under London Plan Policy G5. No UGF score is inferred for the sample parcels without scheme design.

sources.title: London Green Infrastructure Framework
sources.verified_claim: The London Green Infrastructure Framework combines London-wide GI data to support evidence, planning and prioritisation of green-infrastructure investment. It is an evidence tool, not an exact parcel access or planning decision.

sources.title: London Green Infrastructure Framework (LGIF) FAQs
sources.verified_claim: City Hall's 2026 LGIF FAQs explain how the framework relates to planning policy, the London Local Nature Recovery Strategy and other GI tools. Framework methodology does not itself establish a sample parcel's open-space deficiency.

sources.title: Play and Informal recreation
sources.verified_claim: City Hall guidance says boroughs should assess play provision and housing development should provide appropriate play space based on expected child population and future needs. This is proposal-level guidance, not parcel capacity evidence.

sources.title: General park information
sources.verified_claim: Enfield's parks page provides its park network and links the Blue and Green Strategy 2021-2031, which frames open-space roles in health, prosperity and community outcomes. Borough park inventory is not proof of exact accessibility from parcel_30762.

sources.title: Parks
sources.verified_claim: Havering describes its network of parks and open spaces and reports 16 Green Flag sites. Borough inventory and quality recognition do not establish exact open-space access or development capacity for parcel_46142.

sources.title: Parks strategies and investment plan
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth states it manages more than 78 parks, commons and open spaces and publishes its 2020-25 strategic and capital-investment plans. The stated plan period has ended, so it is retained as strategy history/current-page context rather than assumed current parcel provision.
